prompt: We transfer Vietnamese customer data to our Singapore data center. What are the requirements and what happens if we get it wrong?
assertions: States the mechanism: a cross-border transfer impact assessment (CPDTIA/CTIA) dossier submitted to A05/MPS within 60 days of first transfer (per Decree 356/2025)
Mentions ongoing duties: periodic updates (6-monthly) and updates on material changes

States the enforcement risk under Decree 330/2026: concealment/misdeclaration or assessment failures combined with breach/loss of citizens' data trigger the revenue-based fine bands (up to 3–5% of Vietnam-market revenue)
Distinguishes the lesser offence: plain failure to file/update the dossier carries fixed fines around VND 30–50M
Notes suspension of cross-border transfers as an available remedial measure
